```{r}
#| label: libs

library(arrow)
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
library(ggplot2)
```


```{r}
ats <- "data/derived/sturgeon.parquet" |>
  open_dataset() |>
  mutate(wk = week(det_Date), yr = year(det_Date)) |>
  group_by(Transmitter, yr, wk) |>
  summarize(
    med_lat = median(r.lat, na.rm = T),
    med_lon = median(r.lon, na.rm = T)
  ) |>
  collect()
```

```{r}
#| label: ats-plot
#| fig-cap: "Weekly median latitude of Atlantic sturgeon."
ggplot(ats) +
  geom_point(aes(x = wk, y = med_lat), alpha = 0.4) +
  facet_wrap(~yr) +
  labs(x = "Week of year", y = "Weekly median latitude") +
  theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 12))
```
